fields.name: buffer_chunk_size
fields.description: Set the initial buffer size to read file data.

fields.name: buffer_max_size
fields.description: Set the limit of the buffer size per monitored file.

fields.name: db
fields.description: Specify the database file to keep track of monitored files and offsets.

fields.name: db.compare_filename
fields.description: This option determines whether to review both inode and filename when retrieving stored file information from the database.

fields.name: db.journal_mode
fields.description: Sets the journal mode for databases (wal).

fields.name: db.locking
fields.description: Specify that the database will be accessed only by Fluent Bit.

fields.name: db.sync
fields.description: Set a default synchronization (I/O) method.

fields.name: docker_mode
fields.description: If enabled, the plugin will recombine split Docker log lines before passing them to any parser.

fields.name: docker_mode_flush
fields.description: Wait period time in seconds to flush queued unfinished split lines.

fields.name: docker_mode_parser
fields.description: Specify an optional parser for the first line of the Docker multiline mode.

fields.name: event_batch_size
fields.description: Set the maximum number of bytes to process per iteration for files monitored in event mode (files promoted from static to event-based monitoring).

fields.name: exclude_path
fields.description: Set one or multiple shell patterns separated by commas to exclude files matching certain criteria.

fields.name: exit_on_eof
fields.description: When reading a file, exit as soon as it reaches the end of the file.

fields.name: file_cache_advise
fields.description: Set the posix_fadvise in POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED mode.

fields.name: generic.encoding
fields.description: Set the non-Unicode encoding of the file data.

fields.name: ignore_active_older_files
fields.description: Ignore files that are older than the value set in ignore_older even if the file is being ingested.

fields.name: ignore_older
fields.description: Ignores files older than ignore_older.

fields.name: inotify_watcher
fields.description: Set to false to use file stat watcher instead of inotify.

fields.name: key
fields.description: When a message is unstructured (no parser applied), it's appended as a string under the key name log.

fields.name: mem_buf_limit
fields.description: Set a memory limit that the Tail plugin can use when appending data to the engine.

fields.name: offset_key
fields.description: If enabled, Fluent Bit appends the offset of the current monitored file as part of the record.

fields.name: parser
fields.description: Specify the name of a parser to interpret the entry as a structured message.

fields.name: path
fields.description: Pattern specifying a specific log file or multiple ones through the use of common wildcards.

fields.name: path_key
fields.description: If enabled, it appends the name of the monitored file as part of the record.

fields.name: progress_check_interval
fields.description: Set the interval for checking file progress.

fields.name: progress_check_interval_nsec
fields.description: Set the nanosecond component of the progress check interval.

fields.name: read_from_head
fields.description: For new discovered files on start (without a database offset/position), read the content from the head of the file, not tail.

fields.name: read_newly_discovered_files_from_head
fields.description: For newly discovered files after startup (without a database offset/position), read the content from the head of the file, not tail.

fields.name: refresh_interval
fields.description: The interval of refreshing the list of watched files in seconds.

fields.name: rotate_wait
fields.description: Specify the number of extra time in seconds to monitor a file once it's rotated in case some pending data is flushed.

fields.name: skip_empty_lines
fields.description: Skips empty lines in the log file from any further processing or output.

fields.name: skip_long_lines
fields.description: When a monitored file reaches its buffer capacity due to a very long line (buffer_max_size), the default behavior is to stop monitoring that file.

fields.name: static_batch_size
fields.description: Set the maximum number of bytes to process per iteration for the monitored static files (files that already exist upon Fluent Bit start).

fields.name: tag
fields.description: Set a tag with regexextract fields that will be placed on lines read.

fields.name: tag_regex
fields.description: Set a regular expression to extract fields from the filename.

fields.name: thread.ring_buffer.capacity
fields.description: Number of slots in the ring buffer for data entries when running in [threaded](/manual/administration/multithreading.md) mode.

fields.name: thread.ring_buffer.window
fields.description: Percentage threshold (1-100) of the ring buffer capacity at which a flush is triggered when running in [threaded](/manual/administration/multithreading.md) mode.

fields.name: threaded
fields.description: Indicates whether to run this input in its own [thread](/manual/administration/multithreading.md#inputs).

fields.name: truncate_long_lines
fields.description: When enabled, truncates lines that exceed the buffer capacity after input encoding conversion to UTF-8.

fields.name: unicode.encoding
fields.description: Set the Unicode character encoding of the file data.

fields.name: watcher_interval
fields.description: Set the interval for the watcher that monitors symbolic link rotation.
